$comment: Previously published as https://schemas.wp.org/admin/v0.json; identifier corrected in v3.0 beta cycle to match the file version.
title: WP Admin Shell — v1.0.0-beta.x admin.json (legacy partitioned shape)
description: Schema for the v1.0.0-beta.x admin.json configuration consumed by the WP Admin Shell cascade resolver in the shipping beta. The MVP flat shape is also accepted at runtime via the core origin loader's normalize_v0 path; this schema describes the partitioned shape that authors targeted under v1. Superseded by the v2 then v3 manifest schemas; v2 shells continue to validate through the v3.0 beta cycle.

name.description: Stable identifier; used as cache key + WP-CLI argument.

$wpds.description: Pinned WPDS version (e.g. '6.9'). Resolver loads wpds-defaults-{version}.json as the implicit core baseline.

userSwitchable.description: Whether end users can opt into this shell via wp_admin_shell_user_prefs.shell. Default false.

settings.description: Capability declarations — what is available in this shell.

regions.description: Region instances keyed by id. Each region is itself an app whose source produces a container.

styles.description: Presentation. Tree mirrors the WPDS slot matrix verbatim — leaf paths emit --wpds-{path-with-dashes} CSS variables. Chrome extensions live under styles.chrome.*; per-region/per-app overrides under styles.regions[id] / styles.applications[id].

regions.description: Per-region scoped overrides (same shape as styles, restricted to leaves).

applications.description: Per-app scoped overrides (same shape as styles, restricted to leaves).

source.description: Registered source id (e.g. core:posts) or iframe:{url}.

userCustomizable.description: Cascade-resolver write filter (default-deny). true = all fields writable downstream; false / absent = locked; array of dotted paths = only listed paths writable.
